desc: Ideation: identify exact convolution approaches and pitfalls.
Implement initial 20-bit packed-integer convolution hybrid (direct small N, big-int general); samples passed.
Implement the parity-split two-square large-N path (even/odd offsets, coeff = E2[b] + O2[b-1]) and validate with samples, self-test, and worst-case N=1000000 timing.
Final validation: N<3, full interval formula, random small brute force forcing big-int path, edge cases around threshold, and memory/time check.
